title: Add AI Health Studio to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [AI Health Studio](https://kreggscode.github.io/health-analyzer-ai) to build
- AI Health Studio is an AI-powered health and wellness web app that uses Pollinations AI APIs at its core: - **Chat Completions API** (POST gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions): Generates personali

Fixes #12742

gist.headline: Wellness enters the greenhouse
gist.blurb: AI Health Studio has joined the build: a community-made health and wellness app growing from Pollinations chat completions. Polli brought a clipboard and, wisely, no medical degree.
gist.summary: Added AI Health Studio to the community app build, highlighting its use of the Pollinations Chat Completions API at gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions for personalized health and wellness conversations.
gist.impact: People exploring Pollinations-powered projects can now discover AI Health Studio as a practical health and wellness app built on the chat API.
gist.visual_concept: Depict AI Health Studio as a cozy digital wellness garden: a retro health dashboard and gentle code-plants represent the Chat Completions API powering personalized conversations. Polli, wearing a tiny clinician-style head mirror and holding a clipboard, warmly tends the plants beside the eager CRT Monitor Robot; keep the scene clearly wellness-themed rather than medical or clinical.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art health-and-wellness garden studio with a retro CRT terminal showing simple pixel text "AI HEALTH STUDIO" and friendly chat bubbles, while code-plants sprout from lime green (#ecf874) pots. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny clinician head mirror, holds a clipboard, and tends the garden beside a cute chunky CRT monitor robot. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle flowers and vines, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
